facts.detail: Active Railway runtime exposes LETTA_API_KEY with the correct variable name; secret value was not read or persisted.
The prior 403 was reproduced as Cloudflare Error 1010 browser_signature_banned against urllib.
After switching to httpx, GET /v1/agents/ returned HTTP 200 and two agents were enumerated.
A real message to the configured Letta worker returned HTTP 200.
Blind probe returned RESET/UNKNOWN and declined to invent the missing payload. This is not proof of persistent memory.
Authenticated POST /letta/cooperate is deployed with fixed worker binding, bounded prompt and R3_API_TOKEN auth.
Letta output remains advisory/data-only and has no automatic canonical-write or external-action authority.

falsifiers: A successful HTTP round-trip alone does not prove shared persistent memory.
The blind probe answer must not be used as evidence that Phase A passed.
Provider-independent continuity requires Phase C without Letta in the recovery path.
next_action: Run Phase A cross-agent with non-sensitive high-entropy canary, worker A/B shared binding, worker C negative control, hashes and receipts.
